stem: Which evidence from the article shows that a large amount of preparation is needed to make traditional animation?

options.label: A
options.text: While these movies can be enjoyable, they do not represent everything that animation can be. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: Two hundred fifty thousand of these drawings ended up in the final movie. More than a million were created overall. (paragraph 2)

options.label: C
options.text: A producer on the film noted that with computer animation, artists can become "very separated from the actual art." (paragraph 5)

options.label: D
options.text: The Japanese anime style of film includes mostly hand-drawn figures. People all over the world appreciate this style. (paragraph 6)
